title: September: Breaking Up with Retail Therapy
coreMove: A shopping urge after hurt is a signal, not a command: name the feeling the cart is trying to soothe, then meet that feeling before checkout adds debt or clutter.

exampleSpecs.domain: late-night online shopping after a breakup
exampleSpecs.audience: readers who use checkout as emotional first aid
exampleSpecs.stakes: Online shopping carts can hold clothes, home goods, and office supplies as fantasies of comfort and control.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Pause the purchase and read the cart as emotional information.

exampleSpecs.domain: new relationship strain during a no-buy month
exampleSpecs.audience: readers whose intimacy triggers old spending habits
exampleSpecs.stakes: Fast trust around money conversations and sobriety can make later distance destabilizing.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show vulnerable intimacy making the urge to buy feel like control.

exampleSpecs.domain: personal finance review after months of denial
exampleSpecs.audience: readers who think emotional spending only means malls
exampleSpecs.stakes: Debt can come through restaurants, bars, coffee, travel, and other soothing routes.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Broaden the definition of retail therapy beyond glamorous shopping.

exampleSpecs.domain: therapy note after a quiet breakup
exampleSpecs.audience: readers whose current pain carries older force
exampleSpecs.stakes: A present breakup can borrow intensity from a past relationship and emotional abuse pattern.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Connect the current craving to an older wound without blaming the present facts alone.

exampleSpecs.audience: readers who buy organization when they feel messy
exampleSpecs.stakes: Office supplies in online shopping carts can promise productivity and control after emotional hurt.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Catch the object pretending to solve the feeling.

exampleSpecs.domain: friend support during a travel day
exampleSpecs.stakes: The first three months matter because connection can replace shopping as a way to survive pain.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show the win as staying present, not simply buying nothing.
